description: Source code for CustomLocaleActivity class in an Android application, managing system and custom locales, including UI interactions, locale list management, and system locale changes.

classes.name: CustomLocaleActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing locale selection, display, and customization in an Android app.

classes.name: LocaleInfo
classes.description: Immutable data structure representing locale information for display and selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI components, and populates locale list.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates UI buttons when activity resumes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from NewLocaleDialog, updating locale list and preferences.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item click events to update button states.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates context menu for list items, offering apply/remove options.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs, such as confirmation for locale removal.

methods.name: setupLocaleList
methods.description: Populates the list with system and custom locales, sorted by code.

methods.name: changeSystemLocale
methods.description: Changes the system locale to the selected locale.

methods.name: displayCurrentLocale
methods.description: Displays the current system locale in the UI.

methods.name: checkLocaleInList
methods.description: Selects the given locale in the list if present.

methods.name: getCheckedLocale
methods.description: Returns the currently selected locale info.

methods.name: updateLocaleButtons
methods.description: Enables/disables buttons based on current selection.

methods.name: onAddNewLocale
methods.description: Starts activity to add a new locale.

methods.name: createRemoveLocaleDialog
methods.description: Creates confirmation dialog for removing a custom locale.

methods.name: removeCustomLocale
methods.description: Removes a locale from custom list and updates UI.
